bibl.title: The Layout of a Military Shrine in Egypt's Eastern Desert.
bibl.seg: Michel Reddé, The Layout of a Military Shrine in Egypt's Eastern Desert.
Agnieszka Tomas (ed.), Ad fines imperii Romani. Studia Thaddaeo Sarnowski septuagenario ab amicis, collegis discipulisque dedicata (Varsaviae, 2015) pp. 39-46, figg.
bibl.note: The sanctuary of Zeus Helios Megas Sarapis recently excavated in the praesidium of Dios / Iovis (Abu Qurrayya) had a place on its podium to house a vexillum.
